# AI Rules

Read and follow the shared rule set in [rule-sets/ai-rules.md](rule-sets/ai-rules.md).

This file is intentionally minimal. The rule set is the policy; AGENTS.md is
only the entrypoint for agents that look for this filename.

## Working on this rules repository

Automated tests cannot prove that an AI understands or follows a rule. Test
only observable mechanics such as generation, installation, portability
constraints, and helper-script behaviour. Review policy meaning manually and
exercise realistic scenarios before treating a rule change as effective.
